preview_evidence: TutorialPreviewPane component (apps/skillhubcore-admin/src/app/(admin)/tools/tutorial-page-content/components/TutorialPreviewPane.tsx) provides live preview of tutorial blocks. TutorialBlockSelector component provides UI to select block type, version, and format. Composer uses BLOCK_REGISTRY (17 canonical block types) from packages/types/src/tutorial-rich-document/registry.ts with full metadata (label, description, category, icon, supportsChildren). Block registry includes all 17 canonical types: heading, paragraph, list, code, example, image, diagram, table, comparison, callout, quote, definition, introduction, summary, two-column, three-column, card-grid, timeline.
findings: COMPOSER: Block registry exists at packages/types/src/tutorial-rich-document/registry.ts with complete metadata for all 17 canonical block types
COMPOSER: TutorialBlockSelector UI component provides dropdown selector for block type, version code, and format (JSON/Markdown)
COMPOSER: TutorialPreviewPane component provides live preview rendering with brand theme support
COMPOSER: Block metadata includes type, label, description, category, icon, supportsChildren, tags for each of 17 canonical types

LSNB: Navigation context preserved via activeNavigationNodeId and activeUrl props with reactive ancestor expansion
LSNB: Progress visualization (R/Y/G) integrated with ILS currentPageProgress mapping (0-49% red, 50-99% yellow, 100% green)
LSNB: Collapsed-by-default behavior with automatic expansion of ancestor path for current page
